faq.heading: What is available on the Seedance upscale page today

items.question: Does this page upscale videos today?
items.answer: No. It previews the planned interface; production video upload and enhancement are not connected yet.

items.question: Is a selected video uploaded?
items.answer: No. Selection stays local in the browser and does not request an upload URL or create a job.

items.question: Which formats are planned?
items.answer: The interface is designed around MP4, MOV, and WebM, subject to final provider validation.
